en.topic_title: China seeks arrest of five Uyghurs held in Thailand: Bangkok
en.topic_summary:
Five Uyghurs detained in Thailand since 2014 are subject to Chinese arrest warrants, the kingdom’s security chief said Wednesday, adding that a court would decide if they would be returned to China.



In this photo taken on September 30, 2022, an immigration detention centre, where human rights activists believe that a group of Uyghurs are being detained, is pictured in the Sathorn area of Bangkok. Photo: Jack Taylor/AFP.
